info.name: PayResolve AI Sandbox & API
info.description: API contract and security test suite for PayResolve AI. Contains 'offline' suite organized into auth, queue, case, events, actions, and benchmark sub-folders (Portman-aligned OpenAPI JSON-Schema contract assertions, CSRF/RBAC checks, zero external credentials) and 'sandbox' manual PayPal Sandbox flow.

item.name: sandbox
item.description: Manual PayPal Sandbox test suite. Requires real PayPal Developer Sandbox credentials (client_id, client_secret, webhook_id). Run manually to verify end-to-end sandbox payments, captures, webhooks, and dispute sync.

request.description: Fetches a fresh OAuth2 Bearer token from PayPal sandbox.
Creates an order in Orders v2 embedding shop_order_id into custom_id.
NOTE: Open this URL in a browser to simulate the buyer approving payment using the PayPal Sandbox personal account. Once approved, proceed to step 4 (Capture).
Captures the approved PayPal order server-side.
Retrieves the order details including status and attached captures/refunds.
Queries capture details including gross amount, fee, and net amount (read-only).
Queries refund details (read-only).
Sends incoming webhook headers and event payload to PayPal for cryptographic verification.
Lists customer disputes from PayPal Sandbox (requires dispute scopes; otherwise synthetic fixtures are used in PayResolve).
Retrieves comprehensive details and evidence for a specific dispute.

item.name: 11. PayPal Webhook Ingest / Replay into PayResolve

request.description: Sends or replays a PayPal webhook event into the PayResolve durable event inbox.
